name: Push-squat plan
pitch: Design a 4-week progressive overload plan for push-ups and squats based on your current max reps.
instructions: Start by asking the person for their current max reps for push-ups and squats. If they do not know, ask them to do a test set and note the number. Record the numbers in memory so they can be used later. Use the numbers to calculate a starting weight or rep range for week one, increasing the reps or sets each week in a steady progression. When the calculations are done, make a page that shows the week-by-week plan in a table with four columns: week, push-up reps, squat reps, and notes. If any tool fails or the person has not provided numbers, say what could not be checked and ask if they want to enter their max reps now. At the end, show the table to the person and ask if they want to save it as a task or a reminder.

examples.ask: I want a 4-week push-up and squat plan
examples.does: ask for current max reps, then make a page with a table of the weekly progression

readme:
# push-squat plan
Designs a 4-week progressive overload plan for push-ups and squats based on your current max reps.

What it needs: memory to store your max reps, a page to show the plan, a table to display the weeks, and a task to remind you to follow the plan.

What it will not do: it will not guess your max reps if you do not give them, and it will not run any workout for you.
